 Vijay Sethupathi And Sai Pallavi’s Inji Vellam Reportedly Eyeing 2027 Release
 Reports suggest Mani Ratnam’s upcoming romantic drama Inji Vellam, starring Vijay Sethupathi and Sai Pallavi, is slated for a theatrical release in early 2027. Official confirmation from the production team is still pending.
 Zoom TV Digital 
 Updated Oct 28, 2026, 23:19 IST
 Inji Vellam First Look. 
 Speculation surrounding the release of the upcoming Tamil-language romantic drama Inji Vellam has begun to circulate, with reports indicating a potential theatrical debut in early 2027. The film, which features a lead pairing of Vijay Sethupathi and Sai Pallavi, is reportedly the next directorial project for Mani Ratnam following his work on Thug Life.
 While the production team has yet to provide an official statement regarding the film's schedule, industry reports suggest that the project is currently eyeing a release date of January 29, 2027. According to these reports, the distribution arrangements for the film within Tamil Nadu have already been established, though fans await formal confirmation from the makers.
 Project Details and Production Team
Inji Vellam is described as a poetic narrative set against the backdrop of Kolkata. The film is a collaborative production involving Madras Talkies, Lyca Productions, and India Talkies. The technical crew for the project includes AR Rahman, who is set to compose the music, while cinematography will be handled by Avik Mukhopadhyay. Sreekar Prasad has been tapped for the film's editing. Beyond these details, the production remains largely under wraps, with further information regarding the plot and supporting cast yet to be disclosed. Current Work Fronts for the Leads
Both lead actors are currently involved in several high-profile projects. Vijay Sethupathi recently appeared in the comedy-drama Baththa and is expected to make a cameo appearance in the Rajinikanth-starrer Jailer 2. His upcoming slate includes the action thriller Train, directed by Mysskin, which is slated for a December 4, 2026, release. In that film, he portrays a man whose journey is interrupted by a hostage crisis. Additionally, he is set to lead Puri Jagannadh’s Slum Dog: 33 Temple Road alongside Tabu and Samyuktha, and has completed filming for the project Pocket Novel. Sai Pallavi is also preparing for a significant release, as she is set to play the role of Sita in the upcoming mythological epic Ramayana: Part 1. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra, the film stars Ranbir Kapoor and Yash and is currently scheduled to hit theatres on November 5, 2026, during the Diwali holiday period.
